estimate_kl_best_effort: estimate KL divergence between two distributions using exact computation or DiCE fallback estimator
mc_estimate_kl: estimate KL divergence between two distributions using the DiCE importance sampling estimator with stop gradient
mc_estimate_kl_with_reparameterized: estimate KL divergence between two fully reparameterized distributions using direct Monte Carlo sampling
mc_estimate_mode: estimate the mode of a distribution by sampling and selecting the highest log probability sample
summarize_monte_carlo_utils: summarize the monte carlo utility module providing KL divergence estimation and mode estimation functions
